scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && npm run dist:win --workspace desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:web && npm run dist:mac --workspace desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:web && npm run dist:linux --workspace desktop
scripts.dist:current: npm run build:web && npm run dist:current --workspace desktop
scripts.test:all: concurrently --max-processes 4 -n server,web,desktop,root -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "uv run --extra dev pytest server/tests/" "npm run test --workspace web" "npm run test --workspace desktop" "vitest run"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently --max-processes 4 -n server,root,web,desktop "uv run --extra dev pytest server/tests/ --cov=server --cov-report=term-missing" "vitest run --coverage" "npm run test:coverage --workspace web" "npm run test:coverage --workspace desktop"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:server: uv run --extra dev ruff check server/ scripts/ && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check server/ scripts/
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:desktop-tests && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run sync:presets:check && npm run i18n:check && npm run openapi:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:all
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run openapi:export && npm run openapi:types --workspace web
scripts.verify:fast: npm run smoke && npm run verify:eval
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify:fast && npm run verify:operational
scripts.verify:desktop:fast: npm run test:desktop && uv run python scripts/desktop_verify.py --mode fast
scripts.verify:desktop:full: npm run test:desktop && uv run python scripts/desktop_verify.py --mode full
